overview_description.description: Pulpix is a digital video technology company offering video personalisation technology that displays interactive bonus content in real-time within your video. Their picture-in-picture platform enables A1:S160 to browse an article, social pages or other information while watching a video. Pulpix also offers a post-video recommendation system that works well for shorter videos. Based on content analysis and viewer behaviour, this is the first platform of its kind in the video recommendation space that enhances user experience, increases video views and increases view-trough-rates, thus boosting revenues.
